title: MT60137: Ceramic And Refractories: Synthesis, Properties And Applications
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Ceramic Materials: structure, microscructure and polymorphism,
synthesis of ceramics, ceramic forming processes, silicate and non silicate
ceramics, structural, functional (electronic, optical) and bio-ceramics, nanoceramics, Properties and applications of ceramics. Refractory materials,
Properties of Refractories, Fracture of refractories, Corrosion of
Refractories, Different Refractory lines, Alumina-Silica Brick, Magnesia
Refractories, Silica Brick, Doloma Refractories, Carbonaceous Refractories,
Spinel-Containing Refractories, Glass tank blocks, Ceramic wool preparation and
properties, Carbide and nitride based refractories, Refractory coatings,
Refractory Castables, Unshaped Refractory Products, Surface Chemistry as a Tool
for the Development of Advanced Refractory Castables, Thermomechanical
Considerations for Refractory Linings, Refractory Applications in Refineries
and Circulating Fluid Bed Reactors, Heating Wall Refractories âDamage and
Causes of Failure, Testing of Refractory Materials, Refractory Lining Design
and Manufacture.
